name: openapi2rpc-ts
description: Generate gRPC-style TypeScript clients (services, request/response messages, status codes) from OpenAPI 3.x definitions

scripts.generate:example: npm run build && node dist/cli.js -i test/fixtures/petstore.yaml -o test/fixtures/petstore.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js -i test/fixtures/petstore.yaml --validate -o test/fixtures/petstore.validate.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js -i examples/todo/openapi.yaml -o examples/todo/todo.generated.ts
